repos_data.description: Keep your Mac awake only while AI coding agents are working
🪖 불침번 — Your Mac's night-watch soldier. Keeps your Mac awake only while AI agents work. No hooks, no daemon, macOS 13+.

Free, open-source notch app for MacBook: turns the Mac notch into a Dynamic Island-style live status area with now playing, a focus timer, your next meeting with a camera mirror, weather, notes, Keep Awake (lid closed too), AirPods battery and a volume and brightness HUD. macOS 26+. Your MacBook's notch, put to work.
Native macOS menu bar app — tmux session manager, Keep Awake / closed-lid mode (lid shut, work running), long-running script launcher (OCI polling, capacity wait, backups). Swift + SwiftUI.
A script to automate tasks when connect a device to your macbook
